text: Cultivation yields fresh crops while building a bond with the natural world. The first action involves watering to sustain plant hydration and health. Correct application of water avoids over-saturation and delivers necessary moisture levels. Subsequently, pruning drives new development and preserves plant form. This practice also eliminates dead or infected sections, lowering susceptibility to pests and illness. Adherence to these two fundamentals allows gardeners to maintain a robust and high-yielding plot.
